notes: Covers the original Nighthawk R7000 (FCC PY313200233, approved August 2013 per DeviWiki); DeviWiki says a December 2018 refiling (PY318300420) was an internal redesign with the same Broadcom chips but possibly different RAM and front-end parts. The R7000P is a different router with different chips.

gaps: SoC name: SmallNetBuilder says BCM4709A, DeviWiki says BCM4709A0 (1 GHz, 2 cores), Tech Advisor says BCM4709. No Broadcom datasheet was found, so the revision is not confirmed.

RAM and flash part numbers (Samsung K4B2G1646E-BCK0 and K9F1G08U0D) come from DeviWiki only. SmallNetBuilder and Tech Advisor give sizes (256 MB and 128 MB) without part numbers. DeviWiki does not say what type of flash it is.
DeviWiki says the 2018 refiling may have changed RAM and front-end parts. Not verified, and no 2018-revision photos were read.
Antenna connector: DeviWiki lists U.FL and RP-SMA; Tech Advisor's spec list says NP-SMR. The connector type is not claimed.

The power amplifiers come from SmallNetBuilder's comparison table, which has an R7000 column and an R7000P column; the R7000 column was used. DeviWiki's additional-chips list names the same SE2623L and SE5003L1 (three each).
SmallNetBuilder's table lists BCM4360 for both the 2.4 GHz and the 5 GHz radio of the R7000. DeviWiki and a photo caption in SmallNetBuilder's first look agree on two BCM4360 radios.
Switch and Ethernet: DeviWiki and SmallNetBuilder say they are integrated into the BCM4709A0, so no separate switch chip is claimed.
No buck converters or other regulator parts appear in the sources read, so none are claimed.
No datasheet link added: the researcher found only third-party mirrors for the Samsung K9F1G08U0D and none for the Broadcom BCM4709 or BCM4360.
Production years: none of the sources read gives them.
fccid.io's PY313200233 page returned HTTP 403 to the checker, so it is not cited; DeviWiki is the source for the FCC IDs and the August 2013 approval date.
method: DeviWiki Netgear R7000 page (community wiki, readable without a bot check): CPU, Wi-Fi chips, RAM, flash, power, ports, additional chips, FCC IDs and the revision note.
SmallNetBuilder NETGEAR R7000P Nighthawk review, Table 1 component summary: the right-hand column is the R7000 (BCM4709A, BCM4360, SE2623L and SE5003L1 power amplifiers, 256 MB RAM, 128 MB flash).
SmallNetBuilder AC1900 First Look (NETGEAR R7000 and ASUS RT-AC68U): BCM4709A SoC, two BCM4360 radios, RAM and flash sizes.
Tech Advisor Nighthawk R7000 review (August 2014): spec list (BCM4709 SoC, 128 MB flash, 256 MB RAM, three detachable antennas) and the text on status LEDs.
ManualsLib, Netgear R7000 manual, technical specifications page 129: power adapter 12V/3.5A DC output and mains input by region.
Netgear knowledge base article 23003 (maximum power consumption for Netgear routers): lists the R7000 adapter as 12V 3.5A.
Refused or unreadable: fccid.io PY313200233 (HTTP 403 to the checker).

Refused to the researcher: FCC internal photo and user manual PDFs for PY313200233 (HTTP 403), DD-WRT wiki and TechInfoDepot (Anubis bot checks), Netgear's datasheet (HTTP 404) and product page (no content).

comps.spec: Broadcom BCM4709A0 SoC, 1 GHz, 2 cores (DeviWiki); SmallNetBuilder calls it BCM4709A and Tech Advisor BCM4709 with ARM Cortex-A9 cores. DeviWiki also lists it as the Ethernet and switch chip
Broadcom BCM4360 2.4 GHz radio (SmallNetBuilder Table 1, R7000 column)
Broadcom BCM4360 5 GHz radio (SmallNetBuilder Table 1, R7000 column). Two BCM4360 radios in total
Skyworks SE2623L 2.4 GHz power amplifiers (x3) and SE5003L1 5 GHz power amplifiers (x3) (SmallNetBuilder Table 1, R7000 column; DeviWiki's additional-chips list agrees)
Three large detachable external antennas (Tech Advisor)

Power adapter, 12 V 3.5 A DC output (the manual lists 120 V 60 Hz input for North America, 240 V 50 Hz for the UK and Australia, 230 V 50 Hz for Europe). Netgear's knowledge base also lists the R7000 at 12V 3.5A
Status LEDs along the top deck of the case, which flash for activity by default (Tech Advisor)
Gigabit RJ-45: four LAN ports and one WAN port; USB 3.0 and USB 2.0 ports; 12 VDC barrel jack
Samsung K4B2G1646E-BCK0 RAM, 256 MiB (DeviWiki); SmallNetBuilder and Tech Advisor say 256 MB without a part number
Samsung K9F1G08U0D flash, 128 MiB (DeviWiki); SmallNetBuilder and Tech Advisor say 128 MB without a part number
